purpose: Movie data model and parser for the encoded ASCII animation format. It defines frames, renders progress bars, and loads UTF-8 movie text files into centered screen-ready frame lines.
invariants: Movie.load is single-use; after _loaded is true it returns False and leaves existing frames intact.
Encoded movie files use 14-line chunks: one display-time metadata line followed by 13 frame content lines.
Frame content is padded to _frame_width and right-justified by left_margin so old terminal characters are overwritten and centered.
TimeBar.internal_length is total length minus left and right decorators; marker placement must never overwrite the right decorator.
get_marker_postion remains as a compatibility alias for the original misspelled public method.
gotchas: TimeBar with duration <= 0 reports marker position 0; callers that need real progress must provide a positive duration.
Movie starts with a placeholder frame until a file is loaded.
Movie.load opens files as UTF-8, which is correct for repo fixtures but may reject legacy files in another encoding.

key_functions.name: TimeBar.get_marker_position
key_functions.summary: Converts an absolute frame number into a rounded marker index within the bar internals, returning 0 for zero-duration bars.

key_functions.name: TimeBar.get_marker_postion

key_functions.name: Movie.load
key_functions.summary: Parses the encoded movie file into Frame objects, padding and centering each visual line for terminal display.
